pages.title: The big drop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is noon on a hot day at a big theme park in Orlando. Screams and laughs come from the roller coaster above. Noah stands in a long line with two friends. After forty minutes, he reaches the front. A ride attendant named Rex checks every rider. A height sign stands next to him.
“Hi! Can I go on this roller coaster?” says Noah. “Let me check your height. Stand here, please.” says Rex. “Okay. Is it high enough?” says Noah.
